formula: retail_total_SEK_per_kWh = (1 + VAT) * (spot + supplier_markup + network_energy(t) + energy_tax(year, zone)); all components ex VAT in SEK/kWh; fixed annual/monthly charges excluded (listed below)
contract_assumption: hourly-spot (timpris/kvartspris) retail contract so the hourly spot passes through; Swedish monthly-average contracts would use the monthly mean spot instead

VAT.note: 25 % VAT on all parts incl. energy tax (Skattebetalarna; Energimarknadsbyrån)

spot.upstream: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform day-ahead prices in EUR, converted by the provider with exchangeratesapi.io rates; may deviate slightly from official Nord Pool SEK prices
spot.terms: provider: free and open, 'for anyone, for anything'; asks for attribution 'Elpriser tillhandahålls av Elpriset just nu.se'. Upstream day-ahead results originate from Nord Pool/SDAC; ENTSO-E asks users to respect upstream copyright. Check before redistributing the raw series publicly.
spot.coverage: 2022-01-01T00:00Z to 2025-12-31T23:00Z UTC, 0 missing hours in both zones; 60-min products until 2025-09-30T22:00Z, 15-min products afterwards (hourly = mean of 4 quarters)
spot.not_covered: 2020-2021: elprisetjustnu starts 2021-11-01; Energy-Charts serves SE1/SE3 only under 'private and internal use only' terms (not used); ENTSO-E API needs a personal token (none available); Nord Pool data is licensed

energy_tax_SEK_per_kWh_exVAT.north_rule: reduced rate (deduction 9.6 öre/kWh ex VAT) for households in all municipalities of Norrbotten, Västerbotten and Jämtland (and some others): applied to SE1/Luleå
sources: Skatteverket, 'Ändrad skattesats för el från 1 januari 2023' (39.2 öre/kWh; north deduction 9.6 öre/kWh)
Energimarknadsbyrån, 'Höjd energiskatt på el 2025' (43.9 öre ex VAT; reduced 34.3 öre; Norrbotten, Västerbotten, Jämtland)
Vattenfall, 'Energiskatt på el för företag' (2024: 42.8 öre ex VAT)
klarsolsverige.se table incl. VAT: 2022 45.0 öre (= 36.0 ex VAT); enklaelbolaget.se/kalkylverket.se: 2026 36.0 öre ex VAT citing Skatteverket
energy_tax_SEK_per_kWh_exVAT.note: 2022 value rests on secondary tables (45.0 incl VAT) consistent with the 2026 rate being 'the same level as 2022'; not read from a Skatteverket page

network_tariff.operator: Vattenfall Eldistribution AB, Säkringsabonnemang (16-63 A) private customers, Tidstariff T4

used_for_all_years.price_list: Prislista Säkringsabonnemang 2025-01 Privat (prices incl. VAT); business list 2025-01 gives the same 53.6/21.4 öre ex VAT

2026_reference.source: vattenfalleldistribution.se villa/grupptariff/effektabonnemang pages 2026 (76.5/30.5 öre incl VAT = business 61.2/24.4 öre ex VAT)

network_tariff.high_load_definition: weekdays 06-22 local time in January, February, March, November, December; excluded weekdays: nyårsdagen, trettondedag jul, långfredag, annandag påsk, julafton, juldagen, annandag jul, nyårsafton (Vattenfall price lists, tillämpningsbestämmelser). Local clock = Swedish official time incl. DST
network_tariff.ambiguity: Vattenfall's grupptariff page states holidays falling Mon-Fri count as high-price time, while the villa page and price-list PDFs exclude them; the package excludes them (affects at most 8 weekdays x 16 h per year)
network_tariff.deviation: 2022-2024 T4 prices were not retrieved: the 2025 list is applied to 2022-2025. Karlstad's real DSO is Karlstads El- och Stadsnät and Luleå's is Luleå Energi Elnät; Vattenfall T4 is used as a documented Swedish time-of-use template, not as the local tariff. Power (kW) tariffs (Vattenfall effektavgift from Oct 2025 for some customers; Ellevio effekttariff) are not modelled.

supplier_markup.composition: Vattenfall variable contract: fixed spot markup 7.00 öre/kWh ex VAT + fixed electricity-certificate fee 1.40 öre/kWh ex VAT (Vattenfall 'Prishistorik över rörligt elpris', valid from 19 June 2023 and from December 2024)
supplier_markup.excluded: Vattenfall's variable purchasing (profile) costs and monthly fee are not included
supplier_markup.alternative: Energimarknadsbyrån: average supplier markup for villa customers ~13.0 öre/kWh in May 2025 (VAT basis not stated on the page)
